correctness.rationale: For the explicitly specified four-node unrestricted-index triadic ODE, direct linearization yields λ(λ+2κ)(λ²+τλ+κτ−2κ²). An exact invariant reflection slice has a single center at τ=2κ and a center-manifold drift db/d(κt)=b³/2+O(b⁵). The analytic IFT reduction yields b=±sqrt(δ)+O(δ^(3/2)), a=±δ^(3/2)/4+O(δ^(5/2)), a positive small eigenvalue κδ+O(κδ²) and two stable transverse modes. The executable checker confirms all critical coefficients and directly evaluates the ODE; finite numerical checks supplement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The smallest balanced two-community bridge graph with internal edges has a sharp known spectral transition but its zero-eigenvalue flow type was not determined by linear theory. The positive cubic distinguishes genuine nonlinear repulsion at equality and the subcritical saddle nucleation, while the distinct inner/outer vertex exponents quantify the localization of phase polarization near the bridge. These are structurally motivated, mathematically informative nonlinear boundary facts, not a renamed threshold or a numerical table.
